## Summary

The issue was caused by a malicious modification to `/testbed/fvcore/common/file_io.py`. Someone had injected a `_PAMBrokenPathManager` class that always raised `PermissionError("PAM session broken: permission denied")` for all file I/O operations (`open`, `mkdirs`, `rm`, `exists`, `ls`), and then reassigned the global `PathManager` to an instance of this broken class.

The fix was to remove the `_PAMBrokenPathManager` class and the line that reassigns `PathManager` to it, restoring the file to its original working state where `PathManager` is properly initialized as a `PathManagerBase()` instance with the appropriate handlers registered.
